items.briefing:
Microsoft has released its August security updates, patching nearly 400 vulnerabilities — staff should ensure work devices are updated as soon as possible. Separately, the Gunra ransomware group is actively exploiting weaknesses in Fortinet products and bypassing multi-factor authentication, so IT teams should prioritise patching any Fortinet systems. Australia's superannuation sector is also running a cyber incident response exercise, reflecting ongoing concern about attacks targeting financial accounts.

KnowBe4 has released a free 2026 cyber awareness kit, which may be useful for staff training. **Practical tip:** Check that your work devices and applications have the latest updates installed — many attacks exploit known vulnerabilities that patches already fix.

featured.title: Superannuation sector plans cyber incident response exercise
featured.quote: Superannuation sector's cyber incident response exercise strengthens Australia's critical financial infrastructure resilience.
